working: Alumni eNews - Reminder: August 2026 (sent 2026-08-16) produced the strongest lift of the period at +686% over baseline daily sessions, with a 47.11% open rate and 1.16% click rate — both above the 25-35% health/nonprofit open benchmark.
Alumni eNews - Day Of: August 2026 (2026-08-19) also lifted well at +52.0% with a 45.22% open rate and the period's best click-to-open rate at 4.06%.

Constant Contact volume and engagement are holding steady run over run: avg open rate 50.83% (vs 51.23% last check) and avg click rate 1.88% (vs 1.89%) across 100 campaigns, both comfortably above nonprofit benchmarks.

GA4's Email channel grew from 29 sessions (0.1% of the 1100-day window) to 56 sessions (0.2%) since the last run — real growth, though the true email-driven number is much larger once the Direct misattribution below is fixed.
Referring Partners eNews - August 2026 (2026-09-08) posted a 3.16% click-to-open rate, the best CTOR of the two most recent Staff/Partner sends.
not_working: UTM leakage is the single biggest data-quality issue: nearly every recent send shows a large direct_sessions_3d spike against a tiny email_sessions_3d count — e.g. the 2026-08-16 Alumni Reminder drove 513 Direct sessions in the 3 days after send vs only 1 counted as Email, and the 2026-08-19 Alumni Day-Of send shows 65 Direct vs 1 Email. This means GA4 is crediting most newsletter-driven traffic to Direct instead of Email, so the true Email channel share (0.2% shown) is understated.
Organic Social remains a weak channel at 5.3% of the 1100-day window (1,721 sessions), essentially flat since the last check (was also 5.3%/1,721).

Staff-Client eNews - July 2026 (2026-07-20) posted a negative lift of -27.3% and a below-benchmark 0.43% click rate, the weakest send in recent memory alongside its Referring Partners companion send (also -27.3% lift).

GSC clicks over the trailing 7 days are low in absolute terms (12 clicks / 1,769 impressions, avg position 20.59) — the comparison window changed from 30 days last run to 7 days this run, so this isn't a reliable trend read; needs a same-window comparison next time.
do_next: Add utm_source=constantcontact&utm_medium=email (plus utm_campaign per send) to every link in the Constant Contact templates — this is the fix for the Direct/Email misattribution seen across all 92 tracked sends this window.

Repromote the Alumni eNews reminder format: the two Alumni sends with the strongest lift (+686% and +52%) were both 'Reminder' or 'Day Of' follow-ups to a primary monthly send, not the primary send itself — consider a second reminder touch on Staff-Client and Referring Partners eNews, which currently only get one send per month.

Investigate the July Staff-Client/Referring Partners dip (-27.3% lift, sub-benchmark 0.43% click rate) against the August recovery (+113.6% lift) to identify what changed in subject line or send timing.
Once UTM tags are live, re-run this pulse and compare Email channel share before/after as the validation check that the fix worked.
summary: The dashboard's biggest blind spot is UTM tagging: newsletter clicks are landing in GA4 as Direct traffic instead of Email, masking how much of the 51% Direct channel is actually newsletter-driven. Newsletter engagement itself is healthy and slightly improved, with Alumni reminder sends outperforming primary sends by a wide margin.
